summary: Split Controller foundation CI into parallel lanes (go, contracts, web, controller-browser, website, host) with cancel-in-progress and storage UI smoke first in the browser lane. API impact: none.

state.reason: CI and local scripts only; no Nex Controller or Core state.

verification.method: Timed a prior serial phase1 failure (~16m): apt 2m, go race 5m, Playwright 4m, then browsers with iso_url failing last. Rewrote both phase1 workflows into independent jobs so those overlap; storage UI smoke is first in controller-browser; concurrency cancels superseded pushes. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_ci_security.py and scripts/check_docs.py --worktree passed. scripts/run-browser-qa.sh smoke remains the local fast path.
